push_type.description:
Type of push notification events.

Supported app types:

- `new_introduction`: push notification for new introduction

- `new_invite`: push notification for new invite

- `new_relation`: push notification for new relation

- `new_chat_message`: push notification for new chat message

- `new_group_chat_invite`: push notification for new group chat invite

- `thread_activity`: push notification for thread activity

- `new_biz_treet_share`: push notification for new biz treet share

- `new_multiple_biz_treet_share`: push notification when multiple treets are shared

- `reservation_expires_soon`: push notification reservation is about to expire

- `reservation_expired`: push notification reservation is expired

- `reserve_soon_out_of_redeems`: push notification to reserve when treet about to
run out of redeems

- `reserve_cooldown_over`: push notification to reserve when treet cooldown is over

Supported biz types:

- `new_biz_invite`: push notification for new biz invite

- `new_biz_treet`: push notification for new biz treet

- `new_multiple_biz_treets`: push notification for new multiple biz treets

- `new_biz_application`: push notification for new biz application

- `new_biz_owner`: push notification when business has transferred ownership

- `updates_from_biz`: push notification regarding updates from biz (e.g. you have
been banned)

- `new_reported_member`: push notification for new reported member

- `biz_application_accepted`: push notification for biz application accepted


To be implemented:

- `new_post`: push notification for new post
